company.shortDescription: Holistic Platform for Chronic Disease Management
company.description: Digi-Prex is a Chronic disease management platform that provides patients with a holistic solution to assist in the management of their conditions. We start by providing these patients with a subscription that allows them access to discounted medicines delivered to their home regularly and provides them access to a full service platform customized to their particular condition allowing them a one stop shop to assist in the management of their condition.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $5,500,000, or 97.35% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,644,225 to $23,019,196, a 4.96x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 53 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 45 (-4).
